newsitem.title: USA: US ag attache-Argentina 97/8 soybean crop 14.5 MMT.
newsitem.headline: US ag attache-Argentina 97/8 soybean crop 14.5 MMT.

text.p: A U.S. agricultural attache forecast Argentina 1997/98 soybean production at 14.5 million tonnes and pegged sunflower production at 5.5 million tonnes, both exceeding 1996/97 crop forecasts.

"Although estimates vary and depend in part on the reversal of currently unfavorable moisture conditions and relative price levels, for the major oilseeds the outlook is generally positive for sustained or increased production of oilseeds in Argentina," the attache wrote in a report dated April 20.
The report was released in Washington on Wednesday. Attache reports are not official USDA data.

On soybeans, the attache said a trend toward the increased use of shorter season soybean varieties will provide more options for farmers on double cropping and also provide less chances for frost damage.
In addition, he said increased use of transgenic soybeans will improve farmers' productivity and output.
In a separate report released Wednesday, the attache revised down the estimates for Argentina soybean and sunflower production for 1996/97 to 12.5 million tonnes and 5.1 million tonnes respectively.
